real_cases.description: Multiple ONUs frequently go online and offline on a PON port
symptoms: All ONUs on PON port go online/offline frequently
real_cases.root_cause: PON port is faulty or ODN quality is poor
real_cases.treatment: Replace PON port or check ODN quality

real_cases.description: Single ONU or some ONUs frequently go online and offline
symptoms: Same splitter's other ONUs work fine
real_cases.root_cause: Rogue ONU, branch fiber fault, or ONU hardware issue
real_cases.treatment: Check rogue ONU, test branch fiber

real_cases.description: Feeder fiber broken - total PON outage
symptoms: All ONUs on GPON card report LOS simultaneously
real_cases.root_cause: Feeder fiber is broken or unplugged

real_cases.description: ONT reports power failure - dying gasp alarm
symptoms: Dying gasp message sent before shutdown
real_cases.root_cause: Customer power outage or ONT power supply failure
real_cases.treatment: Restore customer power or replace ONT power supply

real_cases.description: Bishan-Thomson fiber outage - third party damage
real_cases.root_cause: Third party contractor cut multiple fiber cables during construction

real_cases.description: Traffic accident broke 3 fiber cables
symptoms: 3 fiber cables with 96 cores each broken
real_cases.root_cause: Traffic accident damaged poles and fiber cables

real_cases.description: Frequent service disruptions in rural area
real_cases.root_cause: Poor fiber infrastructure, multiple causes

real_cases.description: Splitter failure - partial outage
real_cases.root_cause: Internal splitter damage, macro bends, or fiber issues
real_cases.treatment: Replace splitter or fix fiber issues

real_cases.description: 1x32 splitter with one branch down - single customer
real_cases.root_cause: Drop cable damage, connector issue, or ONT fault

real_cases.description: Macro bend in distribution fiber - affects single branch
real_cases.root_cause: Macro bend in fiber causing excess attenuation
real_cases.treatment: Locate and fix macro bend in fiber

real_cases.description: Macro bend causing 4dB loss on one branch
symptoms: Problem in fiber closure or distribution box
real_cases.root_cause: Macro bend from improper fiber handling (4dB loss = 8dB at 1650nm)

real_cases.description: Poor ODN quality - multiple symptoms
real_cases.root_cause: Large reflection, attenuation from improper ODN construction

real_cases.description: Rogue ONU causing upstream errors on GPON
real_cases.root_cause: Uncontrolled ONU emitting abnormal light-wave

real_cases.description: OLT board failure - all PONs affected
symptoms: All PON ports on a board affected
real_cases.root_cause: Board or slot hardware failure
real_cases.treatment: Replace board or move services to backup

real_cases.description: OLT temperature high - thermal throttling
real_cases.root_cause: Cooling failure, high ambient temperature, fan failure
real_cases.treatment: Check cooling system, reduce load, improve ventilation

real_cases.description: LOID mismatch - ONT not registering
real_cases.root_cause: LOID on ONT doesn't match OLT PON port configuration

real_cases.description: Authentication failure after new ONT
real_cases.root_cause: Account credentials mismatch or ONT not registered properly

real_cases.description: Normal ONT operation - no issues
real_cases.root_cause: N/A - normal operation

real_cases.description: Planned maintenance window
real_cases.root_cause: Planned network maintenance

real_cases.description: Peak hour congestion on uplink
real_cases.root_cause: Insufficient uplink capacity for peak demand

real_cases.description: Uplink port down - redundancy activated
real_cases.root_cause: Uplink cable or port failure
